description: E205. The words of what a person or the sending source states about a version: what a volume's samples are (with a velocity's kind and unit) and whether a trajectory is the plan or what was drilled. `reasons`: why a statement was refused, one closed key each, one sentence each. `labels`: the word a person reads for each stored value, and for a statement not made. `unavailable`: the sentence every request carrying a statement answers until statements are served. A unit's class is named as a person reads it: the `quantities` word of ophiolite.table-kind-words/1 where it lists the class, otherwise the unit registry's class name. Placeholders are in braces; no sentence carries a code.

reasons.holds-not-a-cube: Only a seismic cube as published can say what its samples are.
reasons.status-not-a-survey: Only a deviation survey can say whether it is planned or drilled.
reasons.velocity-type-missing: Velocities need their kind: interval, average or RMS.
reasons.velocity-unit-missing: Velocities need their unit, such as m/s.
reasons.velocity-type-not-velocity: Only velocities have a kind; leave it out for these samples.
reasons.velocity-unit-not-velocity: Only velocities have a unit here; leave it out for these samples.
reasons.unit-unknown: {unit} is not a unit the units table knows.
reasons.unit-not-velocity: {unit} is a unit of {class}, not of velocity.

unavailable: Labels on volumes and trajectories are not available on this deployment yet.
